# VOUT Connect — Sovereign Cloud & Architecture Gateway
> Official developer gateway for Agustín Milesi and the VOUT Software Ecosystem.

## Creator
- Name: Agustín Milesi
- Title: Lead Full Stack & Mobile Software Architect
- GitHub: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi
- Contact Portal: https://agustinmilesi-contact.vercel.app

## Software Ecosystem Nodes
- VOUT Retail (POS / ERP): https://milesi-erp.vercel.app
  Point of Sale with barcode scanning, blind drawer reconciliation, thermal printing.
- VOUT Web & Mobile (Personal Finance): https://vout-web.vercel.app
  Multi-currency tracker with bi-directional Neon PostgreSQL sync and offline-first mobile app.
- VOUT Inbox (CRM / Feedback SaaS): https://saas-am.vercel.app
  Multi-tenant customer communication pipeline with HMAC-signed webhooks.
- VOUT Cargo (Logistics OS): https://cargo-am.vercel.app
  Freight forwarding and customs clearance platform with container BL tracking.

## Technical Standards
- Next.js 16 + React 19 + Turbopack + Tailwind CSS v4
- React Native + Expo SDK 58
- PostgreSQL on Neon Serverless with Prisma ORM
- TLS 1.3 encrypted endpoints with sliding-window DDoS rate limiting
